question: Which additional native neutral-field responses repair the information lost by the rank-one P0 port, and under which source-alignment assumptions?
summary_de: Die ursprüngliche neutrale Quelle enthält mehr Information als ihr P0-Port: Norm und vorhandene Dreipunktantwort bleiben für (0,4,-8) und (2,-6,2) gleich. Die aus derselben Quelle berechnete verbundene Vierpunktantwort unterscheidet sie und identifiziert (0,4,-8) im festen 5+2+1-Blockraum eindeutig. Zwei gemischte Antworten auf die nativen Sektor-Stressfelder rekonstruieren die Blockkoeffizienten sogar linear. Ohne feste Ausrichtung bleiben isospektrale quadratische Felder durch sämtliche Selbstantworten ununterscheidbar. Physische Messauswahl und 5/4-Suszeptibilität sind nicht hergeleitet.
summary_en: The original neutral source retains more information than its P0 port: norm and the existing three-point response coincide for (0,4,-8) and (2,-6,2). Its connected four-point response distinguishes them and uniquely identifies (0,4,-8) in the fixed 5+2+1 block class. Two mixed responses to native sector stress fields reconstruct the block coefficients linearly. Without fixed alignment, isospectral quadratic fields retain identical self-responses of every order. Physical measurement selection and the 5/4 susceptibility are not derived.
scope: Exact vacuum Wick responses of original neutral_source_response.py with fixed native rank5,2,1 projectors and block-scalar quadratic primaries; algebraic identifiability, not physical source selection or susceptibility derivation.
assumptions: Original native P5,P2,P1 projectors and oscillator vacuum contraction; no replacement source or fitted kernel.
Uniqueness assertion restricts candidates to aP5+bP2+cP1 with 5a+2b+c=0 and a fixed marked sector dictionary.
Connected four-point response or mixed sector stress responses are additional observables beyond the scalar P0 port.
Original vacuum Wick state and exact coefficients; physical detector access, defect-state transfer and noisy reconstruction are not established.
positive_results: Native connected four-point response has coefficient Tr(R^4)=4608, obtained by explicit Wick cycles.
Exact elimination proves unique coefficients (0,4,-8) from primarity and moments (96,-384,4608) in the fixed three-block class.
Mixed native sector responses reconstruct a=2m5/5, b=m2, c=-2(m5+m2) in that class.
kills: Claim that adding the existing cubic response alone repairs scalar P0 identifiability: (2,-6,2) has the same norm and cubic.
Claim that self-correlators alone identify carrier alignment for arbitrary quadratic matrices: an exact isospectral witness changes the D5 block trace.
leaves_open: Derive physical detector access to the native sector-resolved or higher local responses and the state/normalization dictionary.
Derive the physical 5/4 susceptibility and readout kernel without inserting them; the selected R still has zero D5 coefficient.
Reconstruct arbitrary quadratic matrices, including off-diagonal blocks, with an admissible complete probe menu.
P1/P2 source/branch/state selection and the physical T1–T8 completion.
novelty_scope: Project-specific exact higher/mixed-response reconstruction and its alignment boundary. Wick theory and the native norm/cubic are prior knowledge; no new general physical theory.

literature.title: Paul Ginsparg, Applied Conformal Field Theory
literature.scope: Section2.3 free boson normal-ordering and Wick conventions; no TFPT source-selection evidence.
